views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Begin the electronics with the I/O module. Press the Nano Board into it, its USB socket at the same end as the power socket.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Begin the electronics with the I/O module. Press the Nano Board into it, its USB socket at the same end as the power socket.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Peel twelve breadboard wires off the ribbon, keeping them in order. Separate them so that each can be picked up on its own.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Peel twelve breadboard wires off the ribbon, keeping them in order. Separate them so that each can be picked up on its own.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Connect VCC on the black push button to V4 on the I/O module.
views.review: Three wires per push button here (VCC to V, OUT to S, GND to G), as in the published guide. Your STEP has two (OUT to S, VCC to G) and looks like an older save of the model. Which is the kit's wiring?
views.caution: V4 is the pin in the V column of row 4 on the I/O module (S4 and G4 are the other two pins of that row).

views.name: Step 26
views.caption: Begin the case with H1. Push the front tabs of H2 into the slots at the end of H1 until they click.

views.name: Step 26c
views.caption: Begin the case with H1. Push the front tabs of H2 into the slots at the end of H1 until they click.

views.name: Step 27

views.name: Step 27c
views.caption: Push H3 onto the other end of H1 the same way.

views.name: Step 28

views.caption: Push H4 onto the back tabs of H2 and H3.

views.name: Step 29

views.name: Step 29c
views.caption: Turn the case over. Hook the tabs of H5 into the windows in H2, then swing H5 down so that its other tabs click into the notches in H3.

views.name: Step 30
views.caption: Lay H6 on H5 the same way: its tabs into the windows in H2, then into the notches in H3.

views.name: Step 30c
views.caption: Lay H6 on H5 the same way: its tabs into the windows in H2, then into the notches in H3.

views.name: Step 31
views.caption: Bring the electronics back beside the case. Press the blue push button into the pocket in H6 farthest from H3, its pins towards H4.

views.name: Step 31c
views.caption: Bring the electronics back beside the case. Press the blue push button into the pocket in H6 farthest from H3, its pins towards H4.

views.name: Step 32
views.caption: Press the other three push buttons into their pockets the same way: white next to the blue one, then yellow, then black nearest H3.

views.name: Step 32c
views.caption: Press the other three push buttons into their pockets the same way: white next to the blue one, then yellow, then black nearest H3.

views.name: Step 33
views.caption: Lay H7 on H6 the same way, over the push buttons: its tabs into the windows in H2, then into the notches in H3.

views.name: Step 33c
views.caption: Lay H7 on H6 the same way, over the push buttons: its tabs into the windows in H2, then into the notches in H3.

views.name: Step 34
views.caption: Turn the case the right way up. Push H8 down into the slots in H5, between H2 and H3.

views.name: Step 34c
views.caption: Turn the case the right way up. Push H8 down into the slots in H5, between H2 and H3.

views.name: Step 35
views.caption: Slide a piano key, H9, in from the front through H8 until its end clicks into the slot in H4.

views.name: Step 35c
views.caption: Slide a piano key, H9, in from the front through H8 until its end clicks into the slot in H4.

views.name: Step 36
views.caption: Slide the other three keys (H9) in the same way.

views.name: Step 36c
views.caption: Slide the other three keys (H9) in the same way.

views.name: Step 37
views.caption: Hook the rear tabs of H10 into the slots in H4, then lower its front onto H2 and H3 so that their top tabs click into it.

views.name: Step 37c
views.caption: Hook the rear tabs of H10 into the slots in H4, then lower its front onto H2 and H3 so that their top tabs click into it.

views.name: Step 38
views.caption: Push H11 down into the slot in H10, then slide it back until it clicks into H4.

views.name: Step 38c
views.caption: Push H11 down into the slot in H10, then slide it back until it clicks into H4.

views.name: Step 39
views.caption: Fit H12 in the same way.

views.name: Step 39c
views.caption: Fit H12 in the same way.

views.name: Step 40
views.caption: Slide H13 down between H11 and H12 until its hooks go into H4.

views.name: Step 40c
views.caption: Slide H13 down between H11 and H12 until its hooks go into H4.

views.name: Step 41
views.caption: Pick up the I/O module, with everything plugged into it, and hold it over the back of H4, its USB end at the top. Lay the USB cable's other end on the table behind the case.
views.review: The module goes on H4 USB end up, as in the published guide. Your STEP has it USB end down, its power socket on H5's tongue. Which way up is right?

views.name: Step 41c
views.caption: Pick up the I/O module, with everything plugged into it, and hold it over the back of H4, its USB end at the top. Lay the USB cable's other end on the table behind the case.
views.review: The module goes on H4 USB end up, as in the published guide. Your STEP has it USB end down, its power socket on H5's tongue. Which way up is right?

views.name: Step 42

views.name: Step 42c
views.caption: Lower the I/O module onto the back of H4, its edges into the notches in the tabs of H10.

views.name: Step 43
views.caption: Pick up the 4-digit display and hold it over the gap between H11 and H12, its digits towards the front.

views.name: Step 44
views.caption: Lower the 4-digit display into the notches in H11 and H12, then let it lean back against H13.

views.caption: Pick up the dot matrix display and hold it in front of H11 and H12, its LEDs towards the front.

views.name: Step 47
views.caption: Fit H14 over the 4-digit display: set its bottom on the top edge of the dot matrix display, then swing its top in until its two slots go over the tops of H11 and H12.
